classification.difficultyReason: Names three supplied lines using their labelled points.

content.prompt: The three lines in the first diagram to the right enclose a triangular region. Name the three lines in the figure.

spec.description: Three extended straight lines enclose a triangular region, with C upper left, B upper right and A below. Decorative source blue lines and red point markers use house black.
spec.mathematics: The pairwise intersections are A, B and C. The three distinct lines are AB, BC and CA; each extends beyond both labelled points.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied geometry and point labels are visible.

answer.worked: Name each line using two points on it: $AB$, $BC$ and $CA$. The letters may be written in either order.
